subject.title: fix(heartbeat): bound HEARTBEAT.md file read size

question: Should a workspace `HEARTBEAT.md` symlink remain supported after adding the read-size bound?
rationale: The patch combines a narrow memory-safety fix with an observable file-acceptance policy change that current docs and tests do not authorize.

options.title: Preserve symlink support
options.body: Use a bounded implementation that safely retains the current symlink path and test both size-limit and symlink behavior.

options.title: Require regular files
options.body: Keep symlink rejection only with explicit owner approval, upgrade documentation, and proof of the intended user-facing behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve symlink support
recommendation.body: Use a bounded implementation that safely retains the current symlink path and test both size-limit and symlink behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties this person most directly to both affected sides of the contract.
